content:
You plan to visit 10 European cities for 28 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You want to spend 5 days in Prague. You would like to visit Tallinn for 3 days. You plan to visit relatives in Tallinn between day 18 and day 20. You plan to stay in Warsaw for 2 days. You want to spend 3 days in Porto. You plan to stay in Naples for 5 days. You plan to stay in Milan for 3 days. You want to meet a friend in Milan between day 24 and day 26. You would like to visit Lisbon for 5 days. You plan to stay in Santorini for 5 days. You plan to stay in Riga for 4 days. From day 5 to day 8, there is a annual show you want to attend in Riga. You would like to visit Stockholm for 2 days.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Riga and Prague, Stockholm and Milan, Riga and Milan, Lisbon and Stockholm, from Stockholm to Santorini, Naples and Warsaw, Lisbon and Warsaw, Naples and Milan, Lisbon and Naples, from Riga to Tallinn, Tallinn and Prague, Stockholm and Warsaw, Riga and Warsaw, Lisbon and Riga, Riga and Stockholm, Lisbon and Porto, Lisbon and Prague, Milan and Porto, Prague and Milan, Lisbon and Milan, Warsaw and Porto, Warsaw and Tallinn, Santorini and Milan, Stockholm and Prague, Stockholm and Tallinn, Warsaw and Milan, Santorini and Naples, Warsaw and Prague.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 28 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

Below is one valid solution. In the plan below you start in Prague (a 5‑day city so that Riga, scheduled immediately after, ends on Day 8—letting you catch the Riga show on Days 5–8). Then you fly from Prague to Riga; from Riga you go to Lisbon (since “Lisbon and Riga” is a direct flight); from Lisbon you fly to Naples (“Lisbon and Naples”); then Naples to Warsaw (“Naples and Warsaw”); from Warsaw you fly to Tallinn (“Warsaw and Tallinn”) so that its 3‐day window falls on Days 17–19 (thus including a day between Days 18–20 when you visit relatives); next you go from Tallinn to Stockholm (directly connected via “Stockholm and Tallinn”); then from Stockholm you take the (one‐way) flight “from Stockholm to Santorini” (so that Santorini’s 5 days run from Day 20 to Day 24); from Santorini you fly to Milan (“Santorini and Milan”) so that your 3‑day stay there is Days 24–26 (letting you meet your friend between Days 24–26); and finally from Milan you head to Porto (“Milan and Porto”) where you spend your last 3 days (Days 26–28).

To check the timing:
• Prague: Day 1–5 (5 days)
• Riga: Day 5–8 (4 days – and you catch the annual show on Days 5–8)
• Lisbon: Day 8–12 (5 days)
• Naples: Day 12–16 (5 days)
• Warsaw: Day 16–17 (2 days)
• Tallinn: Day 17–19 (3 days; relatives visited on, say, Day 18)
• Stockholm: Day 19–20 (2 days)
• Santorini: Day 20–24 (5 days)
• Milan: Day 24–26 (3 days; your friend–meeting occurs on, for example, Day 24 or 25)
• Porto: Day 26–28 (3 days)

All the flights between consecutive cities appear among the following direct connections:
 • Prague–Riga (“Riga and Prague”)
 • Riga–Lisbon (“Lisbon and Riga”)
 • Lisbon–Naples (“Lisbon and Naples”)
 • Naples–Warsaw (“Naples and Warsaw”)
 • Warsaw–Tallinn (“Warsaw and Tallinn”)
 • Tallinn–Stockholm (“Stockholm and Tallinn”)
 • Stockholm–Santorini (the one‐way “from Stockholm to Santorini”)
 • Santorini–Milan (“Santorini and Milan”)
 • Milan–Porto (“Milan and Porto”)

When you depart a city on its last day the same day is counted in both cities’ intervals.

Below is the JSON output in the requested format:

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"day_range": "Day 1-5", "place": "Prague"},
    {"day_range": "Day 5-8", "place": "Riga"},
    {"day_range": "Day 8-12", "place": "Lisbon"},
    {"day_range": "Day 12-16", "place": "Naples"},
    {"day_range": "Day 16-17", "place": "Warsaw"},
    {"day_range": "Day 17-19", "place": "Tallinn"},
    {"day_range": "Day 19-20", "place": "Stockholm"},
    {"day_range": "Day 20-24", "place": "Santorini"},
    {"day_range": "Day 24-26", "place": "Milan"},
    {"day_range": "Day 26-28", "place": "Porto"}
  ]
}

This itinerary satisfies all the duration and day‐bound constraints while ensuring that every move is by a direct flight according to the list.
